feedback_interpretation: At 150 µL, diethyl bromomalonate finished at 10.43 mL at 2/1 versus 14.04 mL at 5/1, while the starts differed by only 0.03 mL. In contrast, benzyl benzoate at 50 µL finished 26.12 mL earlier at 50/1 than at 100/1. These results motivate a load check for the former and a fixed-load ratio extension for the latter. The methyl benzoylformate middle-load finish exceeded both outer loads at 2/1, and the earlier 4-nitrobenzaldehyde 2/1 finish gap remained below its proposed threshold. Neither a monotone loading rule nor a fixed finish shift is warranted.
